title: Sample Preparation for Mass Spectrometry Using ZipTip C18
author: Neilier Junior
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be45jgy6
materials: Calibrate the P-10 pipette to 10 μL.
Name 4 microtubes of 1.5 mL with the respective reagents: ACN 100% (I) TFA 0.1% (I) TFA 0.1% (II) ACN 100% (II) Add 1 mL of the respective solutions to the tubes above.

steps.title: Prepare collection tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 0.2 mL microtubes for sample collection.

substeps.instruction: Name new 0.2 mL microtubes with sample names followed by “zt”.
Aliquot 50 μL of 100% ACN into each “zt” tube.

steps.title: Prepare ZipTip
steps.instruction: Fit the ZipTip to the pipette and ensure no air enters the chromatographic column.

substeps.instruction: Fit the ZipTip with the pipette already attached.
Hold down until the first pipetting procedure begins.
Pipette the acetonitrile from the ACN 100% (I) tube 10 times, discarding contents onto kimwipes.
Pipette the acetonitrile from the TFA 0.1% (I) tube 10 times, discarding contents onto kimwipes.

steps.title: Bind peptides
steps.instruction: Bind the analyte peptides to the ZipTip.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize the sample with the ZipTip 20 times.
Pipette the acetonitrile from the TFA 0.1% (II) tube 10 times, discarding contents onto kimwipes.

steps.title: Elute peptides
steps.instruction: Elute the peptides into the prepared collection tube.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize 20 times in the “zt” tube containing 50 μL of 100% ACN.
Pipette the acetonitrile from the ACN 100% (II) tube 10 times, discarding the contents into the “zt” tube.
